name: Other item components: names, lore, enchantments, attributes, potions, food, containers, books, maps, dyes, fireworks, trims and the rest
note: Every component type of both protocols is read, checked against its registries and kept losslessly in canonical form (schema compiled from minecraft-data); 29 components have a save form for Anvil interchange
deviations: components that refer to registries the server does not synchronize (enchantments, trim materials and patterns, banner patterns, instruments, jukebox songs, data component predicates) are refused
the rules use only damage, max stack size and max damage, and for eating and drinking a potion's contents, a suspicious stew's effects and an ominous bottle's amplifier
a stack's components are written in type order; the official servers write a patch in the order its components were set (clients read it as a map; client/special_a)
